compositions.aesthetic_rasa: Śānta & Bhakti (Supreme detachment and spiritual wealth)
compositions.meaning_summary: Is wealth (nidhi) truly productive of happiness, or is the close proximity and devotion to the lotus feet of Lord Rama far superior? Tyagaraja contemplates true inner riches over material gold.

compositions.aesthetic_rasa: Karuṇa & Bhakti (Pleading yearning for the divine smile)
compositions.meaning_summary: If I cannot behold your smiling countenance, O Rama, what is the use of my eyes? Without your grace, my life is rendered completely meaningless.

compositions.title: Mariyāda Kādayyā

scale.arohana: S R2 G2 M1 P D1 N2 Ṡ
scale.avarohana: Ṡ N2 D1 P M1 G2 R2 S

compositions.aesthetic_rasa: Karuṇa (Deep emotional appeal and questioning grace)
compositions.meaning_summary: Is it fair or dignified (mariyada) on your part to test my patience thus, O Rama? You are the ocean of mercy, yet you remain silent to my cries.
